name: word-cloud
description: A word-cloud is a chart type that visually displays text data, reflecting the importance or frequency of words in the text by adjusting their size, color, and position. A word-cloud transforms text information into an intuitive visual representation, allowing users to quickly identify keywords and themes in the text. Word clouds are particularly suitable for analyzing large amounts of text data, such as social media comments, user feedback, article content, and survey reports. By comparing the size of the words, users can quickly understand which words are most important or appear most frequently, thereby extracting the core information and trends of the text.

data.description: Data for word-cloud chart, it should be an array of objects, each object contains a `text` field and a `value` field, such as, [{ value: 4.272, text: '形成' }].

theme.description: Set the theme for the chart, optional, default is 'default'.

style.description: Style configuration for the chart with a JSON object, optional.

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the chart, such as, '#fff'.

palette.description: Color palette for the chart, it is a collection of colors.

texture.description: Set the texture for the chart, optional, default is 'default'. 'rough' refers to hand-drawn style.

width.description: Set the width of chart, default is 600.

height.description: Set the height of chart, default is 400.
